briefing: Your docking fee at {HERE} is paid, so listen. I am {PATRON}, port administrator, and the harvest quota is short again this cycle.
An Anaconda is forging the harvest numbers. Hold it on your scanner, do not fire, then find the ship that carries the false papers and end it.
I do not apologise for the queue. Do the job, report to me, and your berth stays open.
dossier.lead: A channel opens: {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants a word about the harvest count.

watch.arrive: Hold the Anaconda at {TARGET} on your scanner, and earn {PAY} for patience.
watch.success: You held the scan at {TARGET} steady, and the fee of {PAY} is yours.
watch.fail: You lost the Anaconda at {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays in my account.

chase.arrive: Destroy the Fer-de-Lance last seen at {TARGET}, and collect {PAY} when it burns.
chase.success: The Fer-de-Lance is wreckage at {TARGET}; {PAY} is credited to you.
chase.fail: The Fer-de-Lance slipped past {TARGET}, and {PAY} waits for another pilot.

trail.arrive: Report the courier's trail at {TARGET}, and I will pay {PAY} on arrival.
trail.success: You docked at {TARGET} with the trail intact; {PAY} is transferred.
trail.fail: You missed the trail at {TARGET}, and {PAY} is withheld.

rumour.far: Bulletin traffic says {PATRON} at {WORLD} is short a harvest count and wants proof.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from one jump out: dock at {WORLD}, she has work for you.

dossier.news: The data page at {WORLD} notes that {PATRON} has work for any pilot who docks.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander logged the job offered at {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the trail closed at {WORLD}, and the commander's report was done.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the trail went cold near {WORLD}, and the job lapsed.

watch.success: On day {DAY}, the commander held the scan steady near {WORLD}.
watch.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the Anaconda burned near {WORLD} before the watch ended.
watch.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Anaconda jumped clear of {WORLD} mid-watch.
watch.failed: On day {DAY}, the watch near {WORLD} lapsed past the deadline.

chase.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance was destroyed near {WORLD}.
chase.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance jumped away from {WORLD}.
chase.targetFled: On day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance fled the chase near {WORLD}.
chase.failed: On day {DAY}, the chase near {WORLD} ran past the deadline.

trail.success: On day {DAY}, the commander docked at {WORLD} and closed the trail.
trail.failed: On day {DAY}, the trail at {WORLD} went cold past the deadline.

dossier.title: Proof of the Harvest
